metas.name: barren plateau - Samtskhe-Javakheti
metas.note: This part of Samtskhe-Javakheti consists of a barren plateau surrounded by volcanic hills. Isolated clusters of coniferous trees are sometimes visible in the distance. The road shoulders here are made from pinkish gravel and agricultural fields with dark soil can often be seen nearby.

metas.name: ferns - West
metas.note: Ferns are a reliable indicator for the humid western half of the country, with particularly large quantities being a good indicator for the temperate rainforests in Adjara and near the Abkhaz border
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: gori - house numbers signs
metas.note: house numbers signs in Gori has two designs, each with the numeral written in a large font and the street name written in Georgian script and Latin script above and below the number.

metas.name: kutaisi - house numbers signs
metas.note: house numbers signs in Kutaisi has a design featuring the numeral in a large font with the street name written below. The colour of the plate can vary but the style will be the same as

metas.name: metal ornamentation - East
metas.note: Metal ornamentation on roof ridges is commonly found in the southeast of the country. The style of this ornamentation can vary and may not run along the whole ridge of the roof.

metas.name: south hills - semi-desert
metas.note: The southeast of Georgia along the Azeri border is the driest part of the country. This semi-desert environment generally has undulating hills and no vegetation besides grass.

metas.name: wind farms - gori/kaspi
metas.note: The only two wind farms in Georgia are both located in central Shida Kartli. One is northwest of Gori and the other southwest of Kaspi.

metas.name: wooden poles - coastal regions
metas.note: Fences made from irregular wooden poles, often connected with wires or sticks, are common in the coastal regions and Imereti.
